lines: His own brothers threw him into a well... This is Yusuf, Part 1!
As a child, Hazrat Yusuf, alayhis salaam, saw a dream: eleven stars, the sun and the moon... bowing to him.
His father, Hazrat Yaqub, told him: Do not tell your brothers.
But his brothers were jealous. They took him... and threw him into the bottom of a well.
Then Allah inspired him: One day, you will tell them about what they did... while they do not realize.
Part 2 tomorrow. Follow so you don't miss it.
